associated.intro: Demo Equipment DE-100 has the following associated handbooks:

warning.item: SWITCH OFF the dummy equipment before any dummy servicing.
Keep clear of the dummy equipment while it is moving.
Use only dummy spares of the stated dummy part numbers.
Wear the protective clothing named in this dummy handbook.

demolition.para: THE DEMOLITION OF THIS DUMMY EQUIPMENT WILL BE CARRIED OUT ONLY ON THE ORDER OF THE DUMMY AUTHORITY.

preface.para: This handbook describes the Demo Equipment DE-100. All names, numbers and values in it are dummy data.
It is meant for trying the editor, the ancillary pages and the PDF.
Send dummy comments to the dummy issuing authority.

dos.item: Read this dummy handbook before use.
Check the dummy indicators before starting.

donts.item: Do not remove any dummy guard.
Do not exceed the dummy rating.
Do not store the dummy equipment in the open.

important.item: All values in this handbook are dummy values.
